name: Oseghale Wilfred
heroSub: From responsive storefronts to authenticated APIs and the infrastructure that keeps them online, I design and ship complete web products for small businesses and growing teams.
aboutParagraphs: I run Wyntek Technologies, a Nigeria-based studio doing web design, networking and security work. I like taking a project from a rough idea to something real and working: a storefront that converts, an API that holds up, a server that stays online.

Most of my work sits at the intersection of the three things I'm best at: building the interface, building the backend behind it, and making sure the whole thing is secure and stays up. I take on both one-off client builds and longer retainer work for small businesses and larger teams.
contactSub: Open to retainer-based and project-based work: web design, backend builds, and the infrastructure to run them.
metaDescription: Oseghale Wilfred, full-stack developer building web, backend and infrastructure for Wyntek Technologies and independent clients.
